name: Palais Garnier (Opera de Paris)
aka: Théâtre national de l'Opéra, dit opéra Garnier

dates.built: 1862-1875 (the campaign years the Mérimée notice prints)
dates.note: THREE SOURCES, THREE DATES FOR THE COMPETITION AND THE START, AND NONE IS CHANGED. The node's exemplar says 'competition won 1861, built 1861-1875'. The Mérimée notice says 'Charles Garnier remporte le concours en 1860' and prints campaign years '1862 ; 1875'. en.wikipedia's infobox prints 'Groundbreaking August 1861' and 'Opened 5 January 1875'. The 1875 opening is the one thing all three agree on.

quotes.text: La construction de l'opéra fut décidée par Napoléon III dans le cadre des travaux menés par le baron Haussmann. Charles Garnier remporte le concours en 1860 ; les travaux durent près de 15 ans et l'opéra n'est inauguré qu'en 1875.

note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026. THE BUILDING THIS NODE IS BUILT AROUND, AND THE REGISTER DESCRIBES NONE OF IT. The corpus's account is entirely about the plan - 'the grand escalier and its foyers occupy more of the building than the auditorium', 'a stair hall thirty metres high in coloured marbles' - and the Mérimée notice states no dimension, no material, no bay count and no room. It records who decided the building, who won the competition and when it opened. The 30 m stair hall and the 1,979 seats are therefore unsourced here; the seat count is on en.wikipedia and is not carried as a measurement because it is not in the survey source. No rights line was read, so no `rights_evidence`.
